method: Read-only condensed React best-practices review of all changed TSX components and their ownership/read helpers; no source changes or new latency claims.

checks.waterfalls: Selected destination code and guarded data start together. CTA uses existing same-workspace history path. Voting complete selection shares its snapshot; required fresh checks retained.
checks.hooksAndOwnership: Effects dispose readers/timers/listeners. Authority/context/query/revision owners hide stale protected data and fence page handoffs/setters. Object dependencies intentionally include full authority changes.
checks.rendering: Full directory rows and details bounded to100; canonical global metadata/counts remain complete. No delayed full hydration. Large voting candidate setup is explicit and measured.
checks.accessibility: Existing semantic links/buttons, modified links, focus restoration, native controls and dialogs retained. Independent unforced desktop/touch and authenticated accessibility suites already pass.
checks.typescriptAndImports: No any casts or new UI/cache framework introduced. Icons still use existing semantic Phosphor mappings. Existing production typecheck/lint passed.
checks.securityExceptions: User forbids successful authorization caching, added cache frameworks and speculative changes; generic cache suggestions do not apply.
